payment_disputed_charge.description: Customer disputes a charge or claims to be overcharged
examples: you need to correct false charges

payment_refund.description: Customer explicitly requests a refund or money back

ride_cancellation.description: Customer cancelled a ride or has issues with cancellation
examples: I cancelled but was still charged
why did it charge after cancellation

driver_quality_issue.description: Customer complains about driver behavior or quality

lost_found_item.description: Customer lost item in Uber or reporting a found item
examples: I left my phone in the car

account_issue.description: Account access, verification, suspension, or login problems

delivery_quality.description: UberEats delivery had quality issues (wrong, missing, cold, damaged)

delivery_timing.description: UberEats delivery was late or took too long

ride_pickup_issue.description: Issues with ride pickup (wrong location, couldn't find driver, etc)

ride_dropoff_issue.description: Issues with ride dropoff (wrong destination, wrong address)

technical_issue.description: App crashes, bugs, errors, or technical problems

other.description: Other issues not fitting above categories
